spec.query: SELECT last("bid") FROM "default"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)
SELECT mean("pnl") FROM "retain_30_days"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)

SELECT SUM("daily_pnl") AS "segment_pnl"
FROM (
  SELECT LAST("pnl") - FIRST("pnl") AS "daily_pnl"
  FROM "StrategySignal"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time(1d), "strategy" tz('UTC')
)
GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT first("positionAsFloat") AS qty_open FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT first("bid") AS px_open FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND "bid" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT last("bid") AS px_close FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND "bid" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"

spec.description: One row per strategy. Trading PnL = Total PnL − Positional PnL, where Positional PnL = qty_at(start) × (mid_at(end) − mid_at(start)). Total PnL is computed per (strategy, mimid_start_time) session and summed, making it immune to mid-session resets. Mid uses bid as proxy. Footer = totals across selected strategies.
spec.title: Selini Strategies — Trading PnL Decomposition (Reset-Immune)

spec.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "StrategySignal" WITH KEY = "strategy" WHERE time > now() - 5m AND "strategy" =~ /([Rr][Ww][Aa]|[Ff][Ii][Xx][Ee][Dd][Dd][Ee][Pp][Tt][Hh]|PortfolioQuoter)/
